newsitem.title: UK: Kuwaiti killed in attack by Iraqi boat - agency.
newsitem.headline: Kuwaiti killed in attack by Iraqi boat - agency.

text.p: A Kuwaiti was killed and another wounded after an Iraqi vessel fired on their fishing boat on Thursday in the Gulf, the Kuwaiti news agency Kuna said.

The agency, monitored by the British Broadcasting Corporation (BBC), quoted a Kuwaiti Interior Ministry statement as saying that the Iraqis had boarded the Kuwaiti boat, looted it and disabled one of its motors before fleeing north.
It said the Kuwaiti coastguard had rescued the six crew members of the Kuwaiti boat.
One Kuwaiti later died of his wounds in hospital and another was receiving treatment, the ministry statement said.
The statement said the boat had been in the northern Gulf, beyond Kuwait's territorial waters, when attacked.
Kuwaiti authorities had begun an investigation into the incident, KUNA said.
